title: Roasted Rhubarb Tacos
description: A unique fusion of Indian and Mexican flavors in this sweet and savory taco dish.

ingredients.name: Indian spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of cumin, coriander, and garam masala

instructions: Toss rhubarb with Indian spices, brown sugar, salt, and cayenne pepper (if using).
Spread rhubarb mixture on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until tender and caramelized.
While rhubarb is roasting, brush tortillas with coconut oil.
Warm tortillas in the oven for 2-3 minutes or until pliable.
To assemble tacos, place a portion of roasted rhubarb onto a tortilla.
Serve with a squeeze of lime juice and a sprinkle of salt.
